claims.quote: Gene therapy ameliorates neuromuscular pathology in CLN3 disease.
CLN3 disease is a neuronopathic lysosomal storage disorder that severely impacts the central nervous system (CNS) while also inducing notable peripheral neuromuscular symptoms.
Similar myopathic alterations were present in a muscle biopsy from an 8-year-old human CLN3 patient shortly after diagnosis.

To assess a potential therapeutic intervention, we administered intravenous gene therapy using AAV9.hCLN3 to neonatal Cln3Δex7/8 mice, which at disease endstage, entirely prevented tSC loss and NMJ abnormalities, while also averting skeletal muscle atrophy.
